ana_csm: Quick heads-up 0 tenants in the new onboarding wave saw delayed activations and a few 5xxs between 05:05-05:28 UTC on 2026-10-11. Marking two renewal-risk accounts. Need a short external status + RCA + office hours link we can send ASAP.

 tom_cs: Acknowledged. Do we know if this touched Dedicated or Private deployments? That will change the credit wording. :thinking: 

 inc_bot: [incident created] INC-2026-1011-05 | severity=sev2 | owner=@vik_sre | tags=[onboard,replay,auth-fallback]

 vik_sre: Triage summary: an auth fallback deployed earlier exposed an edge case where legacy SDK tokens produced intermittent 401s; clients retried which gaslighted the replay scheduler and caused a backlog for shared onboarding pipelines. A small number of Dedicated instances with mixed auth modes were impacted as well.

 lee_infra: Telemetry: auth_fallback_errors peaked at 6.9% (baseline 0.05%). Replay backlog peaked at 142 -> baseline ~12. Rollback + targeted patch at 4387654405; replays resumed at 4387654430 and are ~62% complete.

 ana_csm: Draft external blurb (short): ```Hello 0 we experienced delayed activations for some accounts between 05:05-05:28 UTC on 2026-10-11. What happened: a compatibility auth fallback exposed a legacy-token edge case that led to rejected writes and replay backlog for a subset of tenants. What we did: rolled back the fallback, deployed a targeted patch, replayed missed batches, and are monitoring system health. Status: reprocessing is ~62% complete and most customers are back to normal. Next steps: full replay expected within 5 hours; office hours today at 20:00 UTC to review impact and answer questions (link). Compensation: Hosted customers impacted will receive a pro-rated onboarding credit. For Dedicated/Private customers we will coordinate remediation and support individually; credits for self-managed deployments are case-by-case. Apologies for the disruption  Redwood Inference Team```

 tom_cs: LGTM. Suggest adding a short validation checklist for customers: (1) check index doc counts, (2) run a smoke query, (3) resend a small test write and confirm 200. Include this curl snippet: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/indexes/<index_id>/stats | jq .doc_count```

 vik_sre: SRE note: patch and rollback timestamps above; added an alert for auth_fallback_errors > 1% at 4387654450 and tightened replay scheduler guards. Postmortem ETA EOD 2026-10-11.

 lee_infra: Postmortem summary for CS: root cause = permissive compatibility fallback that accepted legacy tokens but left a validation gap; impact amplified by client retries and lack of early backpressure. Fix = rollback + strict fallback validation + replay idempotency + improved SDK guidance. Will attach traces and a short log excerpt in the postmortem doc.

 ana_csm: Tom  please send the external message to affected tenants and CC me; I'll own renewal-risk outreach and credit eligibility. We'll capture customer feedback in office hours and fold asks into the postmortem.

 tom_cs: Sending now, office hours link included. I'll post an internal-only follow-up with the impacted account list.

 inc_bot: [update] INC-2026-1011-05 | mitigation=rollback,auth_patch | replay_progress=62% | status=monitoring

 vik_sre: Monitoring replays; will DM CS if any replay job exceeds 6 hours.

 lee_infra: Attaching relevant metric snapshots and a short log snippet to the postmortem draft for CS reference.

 ana_csm: Thanks team  closing loop for CS prep.
